description_en: Obtains the analysis results of multiple Hive databases at a time
description_zh: 批量获取 Hive 库维度分析结果
kebab_example: aliyun emr list-doctor-hive-databases --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c-b933c5aac8fe0000 --date-time 2023-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDoctorHiveDatabases

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.help_zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 一次获取的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The order in which you want to sort the query results. Valid values:

ASC: in ascending order
DESC: in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值：

ASC：升序排列

DESC：降序排列
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The basis on which you want to sort the query results. Valid values:

tableCount: the number of tables
parameters.help_zh:
排序依据。取值：

tableCount：表数量
parameters.name: order_by

Data.description_en: The analysis results of Hive databases

HiveDistributionScore.description_en: The score for the distribution of files of different sizes stored in the Hive database

HiveFormatScore.description_en: The score for the distribution of files stored in different formats in the Hive database

HiveFrequencyScore.description_en: The score for the access frequency of the Hive database

HiveScore.description_en: The overall score of the Hive database

Formats.description_en: The information from the perspective of storage formats

FormatDayGrowthSize.description_en: The daily increment of storage format-specific data
